description.zh:
数据ID。配合BizType使用：

- BizType为AUTH_ZONE时传ZoneID。
- BizType为RESOLVERRULE时传转发规则ID。
description.en:
The data ID. This parameter is used with BizType.

- If BizType is set to AUTH\_ZONE, set this parameter to the zone ID.

- If BizType is set to RESOLVER\_RULE, set this parameter to the forwarding rule ID.

description.zh:
业务类型。取值：

- AUTH_ZONE：权威Zone。
- RESOLVER_RULE：转发规则。
description.en:
The business type. Valid values:

- AUTH\_ZONE: An authoritative zone.

- RESOLVER\_RULE: A forwarding rule.
The end of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.

description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh：中文。

- en：英文。

默认值：en
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese.

- en: English.

Default value: en.
The start of the time range to query. This is a UNIX timestamp.
The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

description.zh:
Zone ID。
>当查询Zone请求量数据时，可以传ZoneId或传BizType+BizId，两种方式取其中一种即可。
description.en:
The zone ID.

> To query the number of requests for a zone, specify either ZoneId or both BizType and BizId.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pvtz describe-request-graph --lang en --user-client-ip 192.168.XX.XX --zone-id 29c752a01cd281a20ddcfa0000 --vpc-id vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000 --start-timestamp 1721036404000 --end-timestamp 1721723624000 --biz-type AUTH_ZONE --biz-id b9c93a8954c4098731e863c04302f45a --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pvtz DescribeRequestGraph --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 29c752a01cd281a20ddcfa0000 --VpcId 'vpc-f8zvrvr1payllgz380000' --StartTimestamp 1721036404000 --UserClientIp '192.168.XX.XX' --Lang en --EndTimestamp 1721723624000 --BizType AUTH_ZONE --BizId b9c93a8954c4098731e863c04302f45a
